question: Motion to Invoke Cloture on the Motion to Proceed: H.R. 7008
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (53-47, 3/5 majority required)
plain_language: This was a vote to end debate on taking up the Stop Insider Trading Act, which would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. A Yea would have moved the Senate toward taking up the bill. A Nay blocked ending debate.

question: S. Res. 817
bill_title: An executive resolution authorizing the en bloc consideration in Executive Session of certain nominations on the Executive Calendar.
plain_language: This resolution lets the Senate take up a batch of nominations together instead of one by one, covering executive jobs, judges, ambassadors, and similar posts. A Yea agrees to that group procedure. A Nay does not.

question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: S. Res. 817
bill_title: An executive resolution authorizing the en bloc consideration in Executive Session of certain nominations on the Executive Calendar.
plain_language: This vote would end debate on S.Res. 817, which provides for the en bloc consideration of nominations for various executive officers, judges, ambassadors, and related positions. Cloture needs 60 votes (three-fifths of the Senate). A Yea limits debate so the Senate can move toward a final vote; a Nay keeps debate open.

question: Motion to Invoke Cloture on the Motion to Proceed to S. Res. 526
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Agreed to (99-0, 3/5 majority required)
bill_title: A resolution withholding the pay of Senators if a Government shutdown occurs.
plain_language: This vote would end debate on whether to take up S.Res. 526, which withholds compensation from Senators during any federal government shutdown (i.e., lapse in appropriations for one or more federal agencies or departments). Cloture needs 60 votes (three-fifths of the Senate). A Yea moves the Senate toward taking up the resolution; a Nay keeps debate open.

question: S. Res. 690
bill_title: An executive resolution authorizing the en bloc consideration in Executive Session of certain nominations on the Executive Calendar.
plain_language: This resolution authorizes the en bloc consideration of 49 nominations for various roles, including executive officers and ambassadors. A Yea agrees to it; a Nay opposes it.
